# Min Sihu

Min Sihu — founder of ActaRoot and OHWUT.

## Min Sihu

Official page: https://msihu.com/

Founder of ActaRoot and OHWUT.

### Founder profile

Min Sihu, also known as Sihu Min and 민시후, is a South Korea-based founder of ActaRoot, Inc. and OHWUT.

He connects a U.S. corporation with a shopping platform built around everyday online purchasing and participation-linked price reductions.

- About Min Sihu: https://msihu.com/about/

### ActaRoot, Inc.

ActaRoot is the U.S. corporation founded by Min Sihu and the company behind OHWUT.

The company provides the corporate identity for the OHWUT brand, with official company information at actaroot.com.

- ActaRoot: https://actaroot.com/

### OHWUT

OHWUT is an online shopping platform serving the U.S. market. It combines ordinary shopping with offers where increased participation can move a product to a lower price level.

Min Sihu founded OHWUT and identifies himself as its founder and CEO.

- OHWUT: https://ohwut.com/
- Projects: https://msihu.com/projects/

### One identity, consistent names

Min Sihu and Sihu Min are name-order variations referring to the same person. His Korean name is 민시후.

This website is his official personal profile.

- Founder FAQ: https://msihu.com/faq/

---

## About Min Sihu

Official page: https://msihu.com/about/

A founder based in South Korea.

### Background

Min Sihu is 13 years old and based in South Korea. His name also appears as Sihu Min and 민시후.

He uses Min and SIHU as shorter name forms, with msihu.com serving as his primary public profile.

### Founder of ActaRoot

Min Sihu founded ActaRoot, Inc., a U.S. corporation.

ActaRoot is the company behind OHWUT, and its corporate information is available at actaroot.com.

- ActaRoot: https://actaroot.com/

### Founder and CEO of OHWUT

Min Sihu identifies his role as founder and CEO of OHWUT. The platform serves U.S. shoppers and includes ordinary purchasing and participation-based price reductions.

OHWUT operates under the ActaRoot corporate identity.

- OHWUT: https://ohwut.com/

### Projects and official sources

The official personal source for his founder background and projects is msihu.com.

The company and brand maintain separate official websites so each has a clearly identified information source.

- Projects: https://msihu.com/projects/

Company building and consumer commerce.

### ActaRoot, Inc.

ActaRoot is a U.S. corporation founded by Min Sihu. It is the company behind OHWUT.

The official corporate website describes the company's identity and relationship to OHWUT.

- ActaRoot company website: https://actaroot.com/

### OHWUT

OHWUT is the shopping brand associated with ActaRoot. Its platform combines ordinary online shopping with offers that become less expensive at higher participation levels.

Its official consumer destination is ohwut.com, where products and shopping information belong.

- OHWUT shopping website: https://ohwut.com/

### Founder's involvement

Min Sihu founded both ActaRoot and OHWUT. He identifies himself as the founder and CEO of OHWUT.

The founder, company and brand are distinct identities, linked by the relationship between them.

- Founder biography: https://msihu.com/about/

### Official sources

The official personal site is msihu.com.

ActaRoot's corporate reference is actaroot.com; OHWUT's official shopping domain is ohwut.com.
